title: Plan used wrong asyncpg parameter name for PgBouncer compatibility
description: plan_phase_epic specified `prepared_statement_cache_size=0` in connect_args for PgBouncer compatibility. The actual asyncpg parameter is `statement_cache_size`, not `prepared_statement_cache_size`. Additionally, two other required settings were missing: `prepared_statement_name_func=lambda: ''` (forces unnamed prepared statements) and `poolclass=NullPool` (avoids dual-pooling with PgBouncer). The plan also included a pool_size formula that is irrelevant when NullPool is used.
root_cause: plan_phase_epic relied on commonly-repeated but incorrect parameter name from generic PgBouncer guides rather than checking asyncpg's actual API documentation. It also did not fully research the NullPool requirement for PgBouncer transaction-mode pooling.
recommendation: When generating plans involving PgBouncer + asyncpg, always specify all 3 required settings: statement_cache_size=0, prepared_statement_name_func=lambda:'', poolclass=NullPool. Verify parameter names against the actual asyncpg documentation, not generic guides. Remove any pool_size discussion when NullPool is specified.
affected_section: Technical Strategy generation in plan_phase_epic.md — specifically the section that handles database/ORM configuration.
